◆Character: Nia (Blade) from "Xenoblade 2".
　Homura-chan (SD), Hikari-chan (SD) and Rex (silhouette).
Situation: Fireworks with the whole family under the starry sky
　└Time Period: After the main ED
　└Time zone: Night
◆Composition: Rex's point of view, Nia is in front of the sparkler.
◆Description: If it is possible, I would appreciate it if you could draw the following descriptions (1) to (6)!
　　　　The lines with "" should be in visible characters without speech balloons or speech bubbles.
　Normal
　　Nia-chan
　　　└The girl is admiring the ephemeral glow of the sparkler and saying, "Beautiful...". (Refer to the document URL)
　Difference 1
　　Rex (silhouetted against the surface of the bucket of water at his feet, as if he were standing across from Nia)
　　　In response to the word └Kirei (beautiful), "while looking at Nia-chan's face," he replies, "Yes...it's very beautiful." She replies, "Yes...it's very beautiful.
　Difference 2
　　Nia-chan
　　　Nia-chan thought Rex was talking about fireworks too, but when she suddenly felt his gaze on her and looked up, her eyes met Rex's.
　　Hikari (SD)
　　　└Hikari and Homura-chan were having a different kind of firework display together, but when she senses a "sign of a sneak attack," she comes up behind Nia-chan.
　　　　Her hair is standing up as if she is receiving a big bang (in the shape of a thunderbolt). Her eyes are in the shape of stars and they are shining.
　Difference 3
　　Nia-chan.
　　　She is blushing when she realizes that the words that └Rex muttered to her earlier were not about fireworks, but about her.
　　Hikari (SD)
　　　└"I won't let you get away with it! I'll let you hit my Panishment Ray! she says, trying to get close to them while holding a handheld firework in both hands.
　　　　Image (Ref. 2): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Q9EeAKVaOqMFnFeZeuvo1ImBhfPxnX-I/view?usp=drive_link
　　Homura-chan (SD)
　　　└Homura-chan, with a bright smile, comes up right behind Hikari-chan when she finds Hikari-chan trying to interfere with them.
　　　　*Image (Ref. 3): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ApnLnLb0RFGWm4lKJMtykpaFq27N2DBj/view?usp=drive_link
　5) Difference 4
　　Nia-chan
　　　└Homura-chan hurriedly turns her head down so that her bright red face will not be seen.
　　Homura-chan (SD)
　　　She is doing "something" to Hikari-chan from behind.
　　Hikari-chan (SD)
　　　She bends her body into a crooked shape and falls down with a strange voice saying, "Ugh!
　Difference 5
　　Nia is looking up with a shy look in her eyes and blurting out "That's the point...Rex" inwardly with a happy smile.
　　　At this time, Homhica is already gone.

Clothing: Yukata (left up to you)
Background: Outdoors in front of the house. (Starry sky and Rex and his family's house in the background)
◆Orientation: sideways

I am sorry for the many differences, but I appreciate your cooperation.

Noah or Mio

Tyon or Yuni
